meta.name: workflow-orchestration-patterns
meta.description: Design durable workflows with Temporal for distributed systems. Covers workflow vs activity separation, saga patterns, state management, and determinism constraints. Use when building long-running processes, distributed transactions, or microservice orchestration.

copy.tagline: 设计可靠的长时工作流与分布式事务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发分布式系统,需要编排长时运行的业务流程。
copy.tagline_en: Design reliable long-running workflows and distributed transactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building distributed systems and need to orchestrate long-running business processes.

howto.what: 它会按 Temporal 的思路帮你设计持久化工作流:区分 workflow 与 activity、写 saga 补偿、管理状态,并指出确定性限制等常见错误。
howto.when: 当你在构建长时间运行的流程、分布式事务,或微服务编排时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个跨多个服务的订单工作流,用 Temporal。
say.note: 会拆分 workflow 与 activity 并给出结构

say.text: 这个流程要能失败后从上次成功的步骤继续,怎么设计?
say.note: 会讲状态持久化和重试

say.text: 检查我这段 workflow 代码有没有违反确定性的写法。

howto.what_en: It helps you design durable Temporal workflows: separating workflow from activity code, saga compensation, state management, determinism limits, and common pitfalls to avoid.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are building long-running processes, distributed transactions, or microservice orchestration.

say_en.text: Design a Temporal workflow for an order that spans several services.
say_en.note: It separates workflow and activity code.
